description: sqlglot-delivery.yml triggers on workflow_run completion of CI, review-verdict and review-gate with no branches filter; the arm job's if (startsWith(head_branch, 'chore/sqlglot-')) is the only scope. The workflow therefore starts a run for every such completion in the repository: 780 runs between 2026-11-11T15:00Z and 2026-11-12T15:00Z, all skipped. The 200 most recent runs were all skipped workflow_run runs, which buried the scheduled and dispatched runs (finding the four 2026-11-11 dispatch startup_failures needed --event filters), and each run enters the workflow-level concurrency group sqlglot-delivery (queue: max) ahead of or behind real schedule and dispatch runs. Introduced with event-driven arming in #4075.
